freeze_discipline.why: The theorems are deductive and verified exhaustively. The instantiation is arithmetic on already-frozen receipts: no episode is re-run, no seed is drawn, no gate is re-evaluated.
post_outcome_changes_forbidden: selecting a baseline after seeing which makes the binding look better
freeze_discipline.baseline_choice_disclosure: Gap fractions are reported against the STRONGEST non-oracle baseline in each family (NEVER_REOPEN for N4-B, RE_DERIVE_SCRATCH for N4-F3), and additionally against the naive baseline for N4-F3. Choosing the weakest baseline would have flattered the binding; the strongest is used.

claims_under_test: Theorem 1: a deterministic zero-regret policy reading only B exists iff every positive-mass B-fibre has a common optimal action.
Theorem 2: refinement never increases Bayes risk, and strictly decreases it exactly when it splits an action-incompatible positive-mass fibre.
Instantiation: the scoped binding closes 7.6% of the oracle gap in N4-B; the typed binding closes 98.4% (vs naive) / 81.9% (vs strongest baseline) in N4-F3.
explicitly_not_claimed: any real-domain generalization -- both families are exact-synthetic
that more typed or scoped state always helps
any change to a family terminal or gate
novelty over donor decision-sufficiency / Blackwell theory
p10 or novelty authorization, both of which remain false in the N4-B record

independent_checker_requirements.independence_rule: No ORION-08 or N-lane module may be imported. Theorems verified on freshly enumerated finite decision problems. Receipts read as data only.
independent_checker_requirements.exhaustiveness: all loss tables over 3 values for the enumerated world/action configurations, and all bindings
independent_checker_requirements.arithmetic: integer; uniform mass removes any need for division
independent_checker_requirements.cannot_check_rule: exit code 3, status CANNOT_CHECK, never reported as a pass

would_license: stating when typed binding has decision value, as a criterion rather than an observation
reporting how much of the achievable value each binding captures
distinguishing a SUPPORTED terminal (direction) from magnitude
would_not_license: reopening or restating any family terminal
touching submission_tmlr/ bytes bound under issue #1601

stop_rule: Complete. Real-domain transfer remains separate successor work and is NOT a submission blocker for ORION-08.
